definitions.explanation: At some point in the future, whether soon or after some time. Implies that the outcome is inevitable.

examples.japanese: {早晩|そうばん}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧だろう。
examples.english: It will become a problem sooner or later.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{早晩|そうばん}⟦{行|い}き{詰|づ}まる→行き詰まる：09346_ikizumaru⟧⟦に{違|ちが}いない→に違いない：18584_nichigainai⟧。
examples.english: This situation is bound to reach a dead end sooner or later.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{早晩|そうばん}なくなる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that due to advances in technology, this job will eventually disappear.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, written-style adverb. Literally combines ⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ (early) and {晩|おそ}い (late), meaning "whether early or late." Used to express that something is inevitable regardless of timing. More literary than ⟦いずれ→いずれ：01789_izure⟧ or ⟦そのうち→そのうち：00380_sonouchi⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いずれ→いずれ：01789_izure⟧: eventually, someday (slightly more common)
- ⟦そのうち→そのうち：00380_sonouchi⟧: sooner or later, one of these days (conversational)
- ⟦{遅|おそ}かれ{早|はや}かれ→遅かれ早かれ：18540_osokarehayakare⟧: sooner or later (set phrase)

cross_references.label: sooner or later, one of these days
